expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and the gesture bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: A solid dark horizontal bar sits across the bottom navigation bar, overlapping/obscuring the middle (search and bookmark/orders) icons. It looks like a stray drag handle, scroll indicator, or mis-sized element rendered on top of the tab bar.

The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza image with the −20% badge) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or price row, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it. The card appears truncated/unfinished.

The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first popular card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item's title is hard-clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') at the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card itself is cut off, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
The category chip row is also cut off at the right edge, with a sliver of the next chip visible, which reads as a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, and the notification bell / heart buttons are icon-only, making purpose unclear for screen readers and low-vision users.
Delivery-fee and time badges use differing shapes/placement across sections (pill inside image bottom-left in the carousel vs. top-left in the popular cards), reducing visual consistency.
